title: Her Gifts
subtitle: Where she walked, flowers bloom
text: Wherever Our Lady once walked, Lethean Poppies bloom — pale flowers in cold areas and along riverbeds. They secrete a dew that accelerates purification, or that causes a Hemomancer to forget a blood memory entirely, severing one tie to the infection. The Tears of Silthmere are this dew distilled to its purest form: a one-time blessing. And somewhere at the bottom of a forgotten river lies the Pallid Icon, carved from pale silver — said to allow an Unstained practitioner to summon a brief apparition of the Lady herself, and ask her what they need to know.
